use default

is_prime(n: int) -> bool is
    if n < 2 then
        return false
    fi

    if n % 2 == 0 then
        return n == 2
    fi

    let i mut = 3

    while i * i <= n do
        if n % i == 0 then
            return false
        fi

        i = i + 2
    od

    true
si

reverse(n: int) -> int is
    let r mut = 0
    let m mut = n

    while m > 0 do
        r = r * 10 + m % 10
        m = m / 10
    od

    r
si

is_emirp(n: int) -> bool is
    let r = reverse(n)

    r != n /\ is_prime(n) /\ is_prime(r)
si

emirps() -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[int] is
    let n mut = 2

    do
        if is_emirp(n) then
            yield n
        fi

        n = n + 1
    od
si

let first_twenty = emirps() |> take(20) |> collect_list()
let first_twenty_text = first_twenty |> map(n => "{n}") |> join(", ")

write_line("first 20 emirps: {first_twenty_text}")

let in_range = (7700::8000) |> filter(is_emirp) |> collect_list()
let in_range_text = in_range |> map(n => "{n}") |> join(", ")

write_line("emirps between 7700 and 8000: {in_range_text}")

let first_ten_thousand = emirps() |> take(10000) |> collect_list()
let ten_thousandth = first_ten_thousand[first_ten_thousand.count - 1]

write_line("10000th emirp: {ten_thousandth}")
